findings.summary: Strengthen CI command assertions to reject commented or disabled steps and environment-based omissions.
findings.reason: Useful future CI-policy test hardening, not a demonstrated defect in the current workflow. The unchanged CI steps at .github/workflows/ci.yml:77-82 and :152-158 were personally inspected: executable moderate-threshold wrapper calls in their correct directories, without failure suppression or dev omission. The changed promotion step already has negative cases for omissions, suppression and ordering. A generalized CI validator is outside this bounded repair.

review.claim_limit: External CLI review of the three implementation files only. Validation receipts were prepared locally and were not part of this export. This is not hosted exact-head approval or release approval.
